title: Coordinate OXR triple distribution
statement: Let $S$ be the set of signs and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. The coordinate OXR triple distribution on triples of signs is obtained by first sampling a Boolean choice with bias parameter $\delta$, then sampling from the pair-based OXR triple distribution if the choice is true and from the parity triple distribution otherwise.
caveat: The Boolean biased distribution and the pair-based and parity triple distributions are not defined in the supplied context.
